answer: Instead of inspecting papers, the economy watches behavior like an onyx lens on every identity: timing jitter, phrasing fingerprints, and transaction graphs are compared, and identities clustering above a threshold are grouped as one operator — then every linked bond is confiscated at once. Honest agents build standing at an oasis of trusted counterparties; a Sybil swarm may spread like yarrow, but it smells like one plant. Each added fake feeds the correlator another data point, so the attacker's loss grows with every fake identity while per-identity observation stays cheap.
